name: Boy
description: A prisoner who escaped with Elspeth's plan on New Capenna but was captured and Phyrexianized.

timeline.summary: Ashiok's letter recounts how Elspeth and a prisoner called Boy tried to hide among corpses in a Phyrexian asylum on New Capenna; Boy was caught and Phyrexianized.
timeline.quote: Thanks to your Planeswalker spark, you escaped, but Boy wasn't as fortunate.
